situation: We're a small airport shuttle company. A customer, Ms Alvarez, booked a 5am pickup Saturday, the driver never showed, she missed her flight to Denver and paid $340 to rebook. She's emailed furious. It was our scheduling error.
reply:
Hi Ms Alvarez,
You booked our 5am pickup on Saturday, no driver arrived, and you missed your flight to Denver and had to pay $340 to rebook. That's on us, and I'm sorry. I've refunded your $65 fare today, and I'll reimburse the $340 within two working days of you replying with the rebooking receipt. I'm Kevin, the owner; reply to me directly or call 555-0142.
Kevin
note: Her whole cost is covered, not just the fare, and the internal cause stays out of it.

situation: ネットで服を売っています。セール品のワンピースを買ったお客様が「返品できないなんて詐欺だ」と怒っています。返品不可は商品ページにも注文確認メールにも書いてあります。
reply: 楽しみにしていただいたワンピースが合わず、残念な思いをさせてしまいました。確認したところ、こちらはセール品で、商品ページと9月18日の注文確認メールに「返品不可」と記載しておりました。返金はできかねますが、サイズ交換でしたら送料は当店負担で承ります。ご希望のサイズを返信でお知らせいただけますか。
note: 事実の誤りは、気持ちを受け止めてから証拠で静かに正す。できないことより、できることを具体的に。

situation: 我开外卖店。顾客在平台上骂得很难听，说送到的酸菜鱼是凉的，要全额退款还要赔偿。确实比预计晚送了40分钟。
reply: 您好，您的酸菜鱼晚到了40分钟，送到时已经凉了，这是我们的问题，对不起。这单我现在就全额退款，另外给您发一张30元无门槛券，下次可以用。我想把这件事处理好，也希望我们能好好沟通。后续有任何问题，直接在这里回复我就行，我是店长老周。
note: 对骂人的话不接，只回应事实和补救。如果对方继续辱骂，说明你会解决，但需要保持文明沟通。

situation: I run a small bakery. A customer, Jess, commented on our latest Instagram post that the birthday cake she picked up Saturday said 'Happy Birthday Kayla' instead of 'Kaylee' and her daughter cried. Our order form says Kaylee. The comment has 20 likes.
reply: Jess, we spelled Kaylee's name wrong on her birthday cake, and that's our mistake. I'm so sorry it happened on her day. I'd like to make it right with a fresh cake for Kaylee, on us, any day this week that suits you. I've sent you a DM to sort the details, or you can call me at the shop on 555-0142. Maria, owner
note: Reply in public first so onlookers see it owned, then move the details to DMs. Name the exact mistake rather than 'any inconvenience'.

situation: I run a furniture shop. I already apologised to a customer, Mr Brennan, for his sofa arriving with a torn cushion, and offered a free replacement cushion delivered Friday. He's replied that's not good enough and he wants a full refund AND to keep the sofa, or he'll leave a one-star review.
reply: I hear you, Mr Brennan, and I know a torn cushion on a new sofa is a real letdown. A full refund while keeping the sofa isn't something I can do. What I can do is either the new cushion delivered Friday 2 October plus a $150 refund for the hassle, or collect the sofa and refund you in full. Which would you prefer?
note: Ignore the review threat. Restate the fix, add one proportionate option, and hold the line on the unreasonable demand without matching his tone.

situation: I'm head of support at a payroll software company. A bug in Monday's release meant 40 of a client's staff got paid a day late. Their HR director, Fiona Walsh, emailed our CEO in all caps saying her people couldn't pay rent. It's our fault.
reply:
Hi Fiona,
On Monday 40 of your people were paid a day late because of us, and some of them had to explain that to a landlord. That's ours: a bug in Monday's release stopped the payment file reaching the bank. It's fixed, and every payment landed this morning. We'll cover any late fees or overdraft charges your staff were hit with; they can send receipts straight to me and I'll reimburse within five working days. We're also waiving your October subscription. You'll have the full incident report from me by Friday. My direct line is 0161 496 0142.
Ruth Adeyemi, Head of Support
note: B2B: the real impact is on her employees, so the make-good goes to them first, then to the account. Answer from a named person, not the CEO's inbox.

situation: 我在淘宝开店卖茶叶。一位顾客收到货后发消息骂人，说快递盒被压扁了，两罐茶叶罐都凹了，要给差评。物流记录显示是中转时压坏的，不是我们打包的问题，但她确实是吃亏的那个。
reply: 您好，盒子压扁了，两罐茶叶罐都凹了，好好的东西收到时变成这样，确实让人窝火。物流记录显示是在中转站压坏的，跟快递公司索赔的事我来办，不用您操心。两罐新的我今天就用加厚箱给您重新发，发出后把单号发您；原来那两罐如果茶叶本身没受潮，您留着喝就好。我是店主阿秀，后面有任何问题直接在这里找我。
note: 不是你的错也先接住她的损失，再平静说一次事实，然后把能做的做到位；差评的威胁不用回应。

situation: I own a small plumbing company. Our tech, Rob, replaced Mrs Dunn's kitchen tap yesterday and she's left an angry voicemail: water's pooling under the sink this morning and she'd taken the day off for him. I'm calling her back now, what do I say?
reply: Hi Mrs Dunn, it's Alan Price, the owner of Price Plumbing, returning your call. Rob fitted your new tap yesterday and this morning you've got water under the sink, after you'd already taken a day off for us. That's our job not done properly, and I'm sorry. I can have a plumber with you by 11 today, no charge, and I'll come myself to check it's right. If anything under the sink got damaged, tell me and we'll cover it. This is my mobile, 07700 900542, so you can reach me directly.
note: On the phone the sequence is the same, said out loud: her words back, own it, a fix with a time today, a make-good, and a direct number.

situation: Last Tuesday a customer, Mr Haddad, was furious that his meal-prep box from us had the wrong allergen labels. I apologised, refunded the week, and promised I'd personally check his next box. It was delivered yesterday. I want to follow up.
reply: Hi Mr Haddad, Dana here from Greenfork. Just checking yesterday's box arrived and everything was right this time; I packed it and checked every label myself. If anything's off, reply to me directly or call 0161 496 0188 and I'll sort it the same day.
note: Follow up when you said you would, keep it short, and don't reopen the apology; the direct line is the point.

situation: I run a small IT support firm. At 8:40 this morning Jo, the office manager at a client architecture practice, emailed in capitals: nobody can print since the update we pushed last night, and they have a tender to hand-deliver by noon. It's our update.
reply:
Hi Jo,
Nobody in your office has been able to print since our update last night, and your tender is due at noon. That's our fault and I'm sorry. I'm rolling the update back remotely now, and Sam is on his way to you, arriving by 9:30. If printing isn't back by 10:15, email me the tender files and we'll print and bind them here and get them to you by 11:15. I'm Priya and I'm on this until it's fixed: 020 7946 0321.
Priya
note: When the clock is the problem, speed beats polish: own it in one line, then a timed fix plus a backup that protects their deadline. The make-good can come in the follow-up.

situation: 我是健身房店长。会员张先生周六早上7点的私教课，教练临时请假，我们没通知到他，他白跑一趟。他在微信上骂前台小王，话说得很难听。我要回复他。
reply: 张先生，您周六早上7点的私教课，教练临时请假，我们没提前通知您，让您白跑一趟，这是我们的错，对不起。这节课已经给您补回账户，另外再送一节，周二或周四晚上7点您看哪个方便。前台小王是按我们的安排做事，请不要再对她说那样的话，有不满直接找我，我来解决。我是店长李伟，这件事我负责跟到底。
note: 对方辱骂员工时，先认错、给补救，再平静地划清界限，把火力引到负责的人身上。

situation: I manage a 40-room hotel. A guest, Mr Okonkwo, arrived at 11pm on Saturday with a confirmed booking, but we'd overbooked, so the night staff sent him to a hotel 15 minutes away. He's emailed furious that he had to take a taxi with his two kids at midnight.
reply:
Dear Mr Okonkwo,
You arrived at 11pm on Saturday with a confirmed room, we didn't have it for you, and you ended up in a taxi with your two children at midnight. That's our failure, and I'm sorry. I've refunded your booking in full today, and I'll reimburse the taxi and anything you paid at the other hotel as soon as you send me the receipts. If you'd like to stay with us again, your next two nights are on us, with the room guaranteed. I'm Clara Weiss, the general manager, and my direct line is 020 7946 0873.
Clara Weiss
note: Name the midnight taxi with the kids, because that's what he's angry about, and keep the overbooking mechanics out of it.

situation: I'm a wedding photographer. I promised Priya and Tom their gallery by Sept 5, six weeks after their July 25 wedding. It's now over nine weeks, and Priya emailed furious that her mother-in-law keeps asking and my updates have been vague. The backlog is my fault.
reply:
Hi Priya,
I promised your gallery by 5 September, it's now more than nine weeks since your wedding, and my updates have been vague while your family keeps asking. That's on me, and I'm sorry. Tonight I'll send you 30 finished favourites so you have something to share this weekend, and the full gallery will be in your inbox by 6pm on Friday 9 October. I'm also adding a 20-page printed album at no charge. If you'd like to talk, I'm on 07700 900617 any time.
Anna
note: Name the vagueness, since that is what made her furious, then a firm date plus something she can share now. Hit both deadlines.

situation: Je gère des paniers de légumes bio à Nantes. Le panier passe de 18 € à 21 € au 1er octobre, annoncé par e-mail le 1er septembre. M. Leroy, abonné depuis quatre ans, m'écrit furieux qu'on l'a « mis devant le fait accompli » et qu'il n'a jamais été prévenu.
reply:
Bonjour Monsieur Leroy,
Découvrir une hausse de 3 € par panier au moment où elle s'applique, après quatre ans avec nous, ce n'est pas agréable. J'ai vérifié : l'annonce est partie le 1er septembre à votre adresse habituelle, je vous la renvoie ci-dessous, elle a peut-être atterri dans les indésirables. Comme vous ne l'avez pas vue, je vous laisse le panier à 18 € pour tout le mois d'octobre. Ensuite, si 21 € ne vous convient pas, vous pouvez passer au petit panier à 15 € ou arrêter sans frais. Je suis Claire, et vous pouvez m'appeler directement au 06 12 48 90 37.
Claire
note: Le fait est corrigé une seule fois, preuve à l'appui, puis un geste proportionné et des options claires, sans discuter de sa colère.

situation: I run a small yoga studio. Yesterday I sent our timetable email to all 212 members with every address visible in the To line instead of hidden. A member, Helen, replied furious that her personal email has been shared with 200 strangers without her permission.
reply:
Hi Helen,
Yesterday I sent our timetable email with every member's address visible, yours included, to more than 200 people, and you never agreed to that. That was my mistake, and I'm sorry. Today I'm emailing everyone on that list to ask them to delete the message and not reuse any addresses, and from now on every studio email goes out so that no one can see anyone else's address. I'm also checking whether this is something I need to report, and I'll tell you what I find by Friday 2 October. I'm Maya, the owner; reply to me directly or call 0161 496 0457.
Maya
note: A privacy slip: own it, fix the process, and check any reporting duty rather than guessing. Don't argue about where her spam came from.

situation: I sell handmade leather wallets online. A customer, Linda, emailed furious that her gift for her dad's 70th on Saturday Oct 3 never arrived. Tracking shows the courier returned it to me because the address on her order had house number 18 instead of 81. I can resend it express today at my cost to arrive Friday Oct 2.
reply: Hi Linda, you ordered this wallet for your dad's 70th on Saturday and it still hasn't reached you, which is stressful this close to the day. I've checked the tracking: the courier returned it to me because the address on the order had house number 18 rather than 81. I'm sending it express today to number 81 at no cost to you, so it arrives on Friday 2 October, and you'll have the tracking number from me by 5pm. I'm Sam; reply here directly if anything else comes up.
note: She's wrong on the facts, so correct once with the evidence, then protect her deadline anyway; the goodwill costs less than the argument.

situation: 我是小区团购的团长，群里有400人。邻居刘姐在群里发了照片，说9月29日团的水蜜桃一箱里烂了一半，骂我黑心只顾赚钱。那批桃确实到货晚了一天，好几户都说有坏果。我打算坏几个退几个的钱，明天中午前退到微信，以后到货先开箱抽查再分。我是3栋的小周。
reply: 刘姐，9月29日那批水蜜桃您那箱烂了一半，花了钱拿到这样的东西，换谁都生气，这是我这个团长没把好关，对不起。这批桃凡是有坏果的，今晚8点前在群里或私信发我照片，坏几个退几个的钱，明天中午前退到微信。以后每批到货我先开箱抽查再分给大家。刘姐，我现在私信您，您那箱我先来处理。我是3栋的小周，有问题随时找我。
note: 群里公开回复先认错、给所有人同一个补救办法，再把刘姐的具体情况转到私聊；不在群里提供货商。

situation: I'm Sam and I run a small appliance repair business. Last Friday we diagnosed the Okafor family's washing machine: the drum bearing has failed and the part is on back order until Friday 9 October. Mrs Okafor emailed furious that she has three kids and can't go another week and a half without a washer. We have a reconditioned loaner I can install tomorrow at no charge, and I can waive the $75 call-out fee.
reply: Hi Mrs Okafor, three kids and no washing machine until 9 October is a long time to go without, and I'm sorry it's taking this long. Here's what I can do now: we have a reconditioned loaner machine, and I can bring it round and plumb it in tomorrow, Thursday 1 October, at no charge, so you're washing again while we wait. I'm also waiving the $75 call-out fee. The day the part arrives, I'll call you to book the repair. Would tomorrow morning or afternoon suit you better? Sam
note: When the real fix is slow, an interim fix with a date does what an apology alone cannot.
